summary: This bill amends the Federal Lands Recreation Enhancement Act to waive entrance fees for national parks and national wildlife refuges on all federal holidays.

scores.thoughts: This bill waives entrance fees to national parks on federal holidays, which could potentially increase visitation. Increased visitation might lead to minor environmental impacts, but the bill's primary focus is access, not environmental regulation or protection. Any environmental effect would be indirect and very small in the context of the entire bill.
